_comment: Public configuration for the /build problem solver. Deliberately NOT in site.json: that file is a Sveltia CMS collection, and the CMS rewrites the whole file from the fields it knows about, so a key it has never heard of gets silently dropped the next time anyone edits site settings.
heading: No problem is too small to fix.
summary: Tell us what keeps going wrong. A few questions later we will have enough to build you something that fixes it — and you will get a copy of everything we captured.
opener: What is the thing that keeps going wrong? Say it however you would say it to a colleague — no need to make it sound like a specification.
_turnstileSiteKey: Cloudflare Turnstile site key. Public by design — it is sent to every browser — exactly like GITHUB_CLIENT_ID in wrangler.jsonc. The matching secret is TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY and lives encrypted on the Worker. Empty until Turnstile is set up; the widget is simply not rendered, and the Worker skips the check. See docs/SETUP.md.
